messages:
maria: Quick sync — partner asked for a combined plan covering HSM key wrapping, HashiCorp Vault integration, SCIM for SSO provisioning, and marketplace listing timeline. Who can take point on each piece?

ben: I can own the KMS/HSM integration checklist and run the demo with their engs. Need secure key exchange details + any HSM driver matrix.

lucy: I’ll handle the marketplace listing content + joint announcement coordination with marketing. alex (marketing-alex) will need a draft blurb and embargo date.

omar: I can do SCIM/SAML side. We’ll need their IdP metadata and a sample mapping. Also want to confirm passwordless vs SAML-flow for enterprise customers.

srinivas: Security will need a threat model and HSM attestation details (certs, FIPS level). @sec-eng please add specific audit artifacts we require.

sec-eng: For attestation: we need HSM vendor FIPS cert, HSM firmware versions, and an HSM-backed key lifecycle doc. Also request for an integration test that shows keys never leave HSM.

maria: Great. Proposed owners: ben=HSM/KMS, omar=SCIM/SAML, lucy=marketplace/PR, srinivas=security oversight. Legal/contract review: @legal-sue will you take lead on data/security terms?

legal-sue: Yep — I’ll start a draft of the addendum. We’ll need to confirm: (1) data residency requirements, (2) whether the partner will be a subprocesser, (3) any export-control clauses.

ben: For engineering, ask partner for: HSM API swagger, example key-wrap/ununwrap calls, sample TLS certs, and a small VM image we can run for local testing.

omar: SCIM mapping suggestion (send to partner):
```
{
  "userName": "userName",
  "name.givenName": "firstName",
  "name.familyName": "lastName",
  "emails[0].value": "email",
  "groups": "groups"
}
```
Also: request single-tenant SAML metadata and a test IdP entry.

lucy: Marketing asks for these by EOD Friday to hit a soft launch window: partner logo (SVG), 50–100 word partner quote, 3 screenshot assets for the console, and 2-3 bullet points about the joint value prop.

maria: Timeline proposal: week 1 = exchange tech artifacts & sandbox creds, week 2 = integration sprint + security review, week 3 = marketing draft & legal finalize, week 4 = joint announcement. Thoughts?

srinivas: Sounds tight but doable if partner provides HSM attestation and test images day 1. Otherwise add a 1-week buffer for compliance checks.

ben: Quick note on secrets flow — prefer wrapping customer DEKs in partner HSM then storing wrapped DEKs in Vault. Minimal flow:
1) Generate DEK in our runtime
2) Call partner HSM to wrap DEK
3) Store wrapped DEK in Vault (transit)
4) Unwrap at runtime via HSM call
This keeps plaintext keys out of persistent storage. :thumbsup:

lucy: @maria can we pre-write a co-marketing FAQ to avoid last-minute legal back-and-forth? I’ll draft and share in #marketing.

maria: Yes please. Also: can engineering produce a short demo script (2 min) showing key wrap + Vault retrieval for the announcement? Ben/omar can pair on that.

omar: Will draft the demo script and a small test harness. Will need partner sandbox creds — can someone request that from their CSM?

maria: I’ll ping their CSM today. Action items: ben (HSM checklist + demo), omar (SCIM/SAML + demo harness), lucy (marketing assets + FAQ), srinivas (security checkpoint + attestations), legal-sue (contract addendum).

marketing-alex: I’ll slot the announcement draft into our calendar once lucy shares assets. Also recommend a short joint webinar — low lift and good lead gen.

maria: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers DM me. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
